{{Otheruses|Archivist}}
'''Archivist emeritus''' was a position within the [[Historical Council]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] held the position in [[36 ABY]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> as well as in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>
